slides.headlineRest: Flaw in WordPress Could Lead to Remote Code Execution
slides.body:
A recently discovered vulnerability, dubbed "Comment2Shell," in WordPress core allowed anonymous visitors to plant hidden scripts via comments. If a logged-in administrator later viewed the affected page, the script could execute code on the site's server, potentially leading to Remote Code Execution (RCE).

This flaw posed a significant risk, allowing unauthorized command execution on vulnerable sites. WordPress addressed this critical issue in version 7.1.1 on September 17.

Site owners are strongly advised to update their WordPress installations immediately to protect against potential exploitation.
